entries.name: Pete O'Neal

expected.charges: Transporting a firearm across state lines (1969)
expected.sentence:
Four-year sentence (fled to Algeria, then Tanzania, rather than serve it)

Verdict as recorded: Convicted 1970, sentenced to four years; jumped bail while free on appeal and fled into exile

entries.rationale: Paul Magnarella’s account based on O’Neal’s recollections places the flight from New York to Sweden in early November 1970, probably November 9. Refine the existing year-only exile start to November, retaining uncertainty about the exact day. No four-year prison term is counted as served.
